![Discovery Alert](https://discoveryalert.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/discovery-alert-logo.svg)

# How the U.S. Sanctions Iranian Oil Export Vessels in 2026

BY [MUFLIH HIDAYAT](https://discoveryalert.com.au/author/muflih-hidayat/)
ON MAY 20, 2026

![U.S. sanctions Iranian oil export vessels graphic](https://discoveryalert.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/8c5e2405-30b7-4290-b405-6c65404c4d44-1024x572.jpg)

## The Machinery of Modern Economic Statecraft: How the U.S. Targets Iran's Oil Revenues

For decades, broad trade embargoes were the dominant weapon in the sanctions arsenal. A country would be cut off from global commerce in sweeping, often blunt terms. The effectiveness of this approach was always limited by the same problem: where there is commercial demand, traders find supply. What has changed fundamentally in recent years is not the political will to apply pressure, but the precision of the tools used to do so. The evolution of how the U.S. sanctions Iranian oil export vessels illustrates this shift in vivid detail, moving from economy-wide restrictions toward the surgical dismantling of specific vessels, exchange networks, and corporate structures that keep sanctioned oil flowing.

## From Sector-Wide Restrictions to Vessel-Level Designations
